title: UI/UX Design Intern
description: Role Overview As a UI/UX Design Intern, you will work closely with our Founder and development team to design websites, landing pages, mobile apps, and marketing assets. You will not be making final strategic decisions alone instead, you will learn how to take client briefs, conduct user research, create wireframes, and deliver pixel-perfect designs that align with brand guidelines. Key Responsibilities User Research & Strategy: Assist in gathering user insights, creating user personas, and mapping out user journeys for client projects. Wireframing & Prototyping: Create low-fidelity and high-fidelity wireframes, interactive prototypes, and mockups using industry-standard tools. Visual Design: Design visually appealing, on-brand interfaces for websites, mobile apps, landing pages, and email templates. Collaboration: Work closely with the Project Coordinator and developers to ensure smooth handoff and implementation of designs. Design Systems: Contribute to building and maintaining reusable UI components and design libraries. Quality Assurance: Review developed websites/apps to ensure design fidelity and identify visual bugs before client delivery. Client Presentations: Assist in preparing design decks and mockups for client presentations (under the supervision of the Founder). Requirements & Skills Educational Background: Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Design, Fine Arts, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or a related field. A strong portfolio showcasing your design thinking and visual skills (academic projects, personal work, or freelance projects are acceptable). Technical Skills (Must-Have): Design Tools: Proficiency in Figma is mandatory. Knowledge of Adobe XD or Sketch is a plus. Adobe Suite: Basic knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for asset creation/editing. Prototyping: Experience creating clickable prototypes to demonstrate user flows. Design Principles: Strong understanding of typography, color theory, layout, and visual hierarchy. Responsive Design: Understanding of mobile-first design principles and how designs adapt across different screen sizes. Nice to Have (But Not Required): Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS (to understand developer constraints). Experience with Webflow, WordPress, or Elementor. Familiarity with user testing tools (e.g., Maze, UsabilityHub). Soft Skills (Crucial): Attention to Detail: You obsess over pixel-perfect alignment, spacing, and consistency. Receptiveness to Feedback: You don't take criticism personally and are excited to iterate on your work. Communication: You can clearly articulate your design decisions and explain the "why" behind your choices. Self-Starter: You can work independently and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. Curiosity: You are constantly learning about new design trends, tools, and best practices. What's in it for You? (Benefits & Perks) Even though this role is unpaid initially, we are deeply committed to your professional growth. Here is what you gain by joining GoKreativ: Real-World Portfolio Projects: Work on actual client projects that will become strong case studies for your portfolio. You will walk away with proven, live work to show future employers. End-to-End Exposure: Experience the entire design lifecycle—from research and wireframing to developer handoff and QA. You will learn how design works in a real agency environment. Mentorship: Direct, weekly 1-on-1 coaching sessions with the Founder to review your work, teach you client management, and help you map out your design career path. Skill Development: Free access to our internal training library or budget for design certifications (e.g., Google UX Design Certificate, Figma Advanced courses). Flexible Hours: We care about output, not hours. We offer a flexible schedule to accommodate your studies or other commitments. Promotion Path: Upon successful completion of the 3–6 month internship and achievement of our company revenue goals, this role transitions into a paid, full-time Junior UI/UX Designer position with a competitive salary and performance bonuses. Letter of Recommendation: Receive a glowing, detailed LinkedIn recommendation and reference to help you land your next big role. Pay: ₹14,000.00 - ₹16,000.00 per month Benefits: Paid sick time Paid time off Application Question(s): Do you have your own Laptop/System and a stable internet connection for work? Are you comfortable with the BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) policy? What is your current notice period? How would you rate your professional English communication skills? 1. Beginner 2. Intermediate 3. Expert Are you willing to complete a simple assignment as part of the selection process? Before we proceed, We want to be completely transparent. This is a 3 to 6-month unpaid educational internship designed to provide hands-on training and portfolio-building opportunities. There is potential for a paid full-time offer at the end, but that is not guaranteed. Is this something you are fully comfortable with and able to commit to? Name the Design Tools you have worked on. A portfolio is mandatory for the screening process. Please share your portfolio, Behance profile, or a link to your design work to be considered for shortlisting. This internship requires roughly 40 Hours per week with availability during core working hours (10 AM - 6 PM ) for client meetings. Are you currently juggling another job, full-time studies, or other commitments that might interfere with this schedule? Work Location: Remote

title: MSBI QA Tester
description: MSBI QA Testing Role:- Job Description: QA Tester (Functional/DB/ETL), in simple terms. The role in one line:- This person checks that the data and reports a client sees (dashboards, pipelines, databases) are correct, complete, and working properly before they go live. What they actually do day to day Test reports and dashboards built in Power BI and the Microsoft BI tools (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS). They compare what’s on screen with the source data. Check Power BI data models , meaning that the relationships and calculations are right and the scheduled data refresh runs without failing. Test data pipelines , which move data from one place to another (ETL = Extract, Transform, Load). They confirm nothing is lost or changed incorrectly along the way. Write SQL and BigQuery queries to compare source data with the final data. Use Python to automate checks and prepare test data. Test APIs to check that systems talk to each other correctly and handle errors. Verify business rules , for example “does the system reject invalid input?” Do non-functional testing , such as speed, large data volumes, refresh time, and security. Write and run test cases in JIRA/AIO, and log defects and follow them until they’re fixed with developers. Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by coordinating with business users and getting their sign-off. Report and escalate to the QA Lead or Delivery Manager, and join sprint meetings. Must-have skills AreaWhat to look forLanguages SQL (essential), Python Cloud/Data BigQuery , GCP services (Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub)BI tools Power BI , MSBI stack (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS)Test tools JIRA + AIO TestingWeb UI and cross-browser testing, API testing, ETL/data testingProcessAgile/Scrum, UAT managementSoft skillsAttention to detail, analytical thinking, clear communication, stakeholder follow-up Qualifications Bachelor’s in Computer Science, IT, or a related field 3-4 years of QA/testing experience ISTQB Foundation is nice to have, not mandatory Experience on data-heavy enterprise projects is a plus Screening tips for recruiting Non-negotiable: SQL plus hands-on data/ETL testing. Many QA candidates only have UI testing, which isn’t enough here. Strong differentiators: Power BI testing, BigQuery/GCP, and Python automation. Good probing questions: “How did you do source-to-target reconciliation?” “How have you tested a Power BI refresh or a report against source data?” “Have you written Python scripts to compare datasets?” Watch out for: candidates with only manual UI testing, or who list the tools but can’t explain how they used them. Realistic expectation: it’s hard to find all of this in one profile. A candidate strong in SQL and ETL testing with some Power BI or GCP exposure is a reasonable fit for 3-4 years of experience.
